scope: User-directed merger of ideas 2/5/6 into a Pleos-main warning/fault record and emergency guidance app with Android backup. Only Pleos-equipped vehicles.
user_decisions: Replace the previous three-warning limit with the full warning/indicator/message catalog for supported Pleos cars.
Support direct and photo-assisted warning lookup and nearby Hyundai service linking.
Retain intermittent fault symptoms, permitted interior/exterior audio and video, and vehicle state.
Differentiate rapid acceleration without brake input from brake input without observed deceleration.
Provide both voice and explanatory Pleos screen animations, including pedal/foot direction and verified emergency controls.
Record all received evidence and the app's guidance/notification actions.
Start accident signaling on recognition, without waiting for media completion or driver confirmation.
Investigate installed dashcam integration and provide help voice for unresponsive/night cases.
Pleos app is primary; Android phone is pre-armed backup for that Pleos car, including vehicle power loss.
Do not expand to ordinary/non-Pleos vehicles.

items.finding: Brake absent must not include missing/unsupported/stale values.
items.resolution: Section 5.1 now uses valid false only and explicitly separates true, false and unknown; future tests added.

items.finding: Non-deceleration branch could include a stopped car or ordinary constant speed.
items.resolution: Section 5.1 now requires motion plus an active unintended-acceleration response or user stopping-failure request; signed reverse speed handling and tests added.

items.finding: First accident transmission could wait for storage or location.
items.resolution: Section 6.1 now starts transmission independently with event ID, receipt time and signal; no fresh GPS, file commit, media or user-response wait; failure tests added.

items.finding: Foreground emergency graphics while navigation is showing were not a verified platform path.
items.resolution: Section 5.2 and phase 1 now require approved display/notification path verification. Section 5.3 separates decision, real audio start and visible screen latency.
